notes.title: UPDATE #2 is LIVE!
notes.content:
So finally we decided to release Update #2 (which should probably be called update #22 considering the amount of new content and changes :-D ). We think it's a massive improvement to the game with so many changes it would probably require a 1000 point listing. :-D

So without further ado here are some of the more prominent changes to the game but far from everything is listed:




Native Oculus Support
Much improved teleporting combined with a change of direction
Collect the Lootboxes for some massive rewards!
Numerous shops are available on the map currently with 9 items to buy and unlock with enough experience and credits!   
Enemies now drop loot of various forms
Experience or XP is now needed to unlock weapons and items!
Credits is now needed to purchase ammo, health pack, allies, drones, weapons and much more!
Mission 1 now is much larger and takes about 60+ minutes to complete
New improved enemy behavior with enemies coming from all directions.
You can buy a helper drone!
Allied marine can now purchase in the shop!
Find the keys to unlock areas! 
Game is now progressively harder with changing environments and harder enemies as you progress deeper into the ship!
Prepare for some epic battles and use the covers found throughout the ship!
Massive changes to weapon handling
Level generation and loading is now 500% improved
Massive performance improvements
Tons of new enemy FX
Tons of new enemy sounds
Massive Mechs added
Improvements across the board to balancing and enemy AI
 

After much internal discussion, we also decided to change the name to X-Fire to move away from the whole Xenomorph/Alien association.

Let us know what you think on the forums, thanks! <3

notes.title: UPDATE #2 is real close!
notes.content:
So the coming update took a bit longer than expected but we are pretty confident that you will find it was worth the wait! The amount of new content coming is mindblowing! The game will require you to move, duck and cover and find the best tactics against a multitude of enemies!

Without giving away too much details here is some of the things you can expect:


Native Oculus Support
Much improved teleporting combined with change of direction
Collect the lootboxes for some massive rewards!
Numerous shops are available around the map currently with 9 items to buy and unlock with enough experience and credits!   
Enemies now drop loot of various forms
Experience or XP is now needed to unlock weapons and items!
Credits is now needed to purchase ammo, healthpack, allies, drones, weapons and much more!
Mission 1 now is much larger and takes about 45+ minutes to complete
New improved enemy behaviour with enemies coming from all directions.
You can buy a helper drone!
Allied marines are now purchased in the shop!
 
Find the keys to unlock areas! 
Game is now progressively harder with changing environments and harder enemies as you progress deeper into the ship!
Prepare for some epic battles and use the covers found out the ship!
 

Release is close, get ready!

notes.title: UPDATE #1 LIVE!
notes.content:
After a 24 hour marathon to fix the worst bugs and issues we can happily tell you that the following has been solved so far and much more is to come. Expect rapid releases the coming weeks of bug fixes, optimizations, new weapons, enemies, missions and so on.

Gameplay: Drop Magazine in weapons by pressing the bottom of the touchpad    
Gameplay & Bugfix: Teleport massive improvement, no longer stops working randomly and you can select angle of room space, also slowly builds up range
    Bugfix:Lightning fixxed in areas which are overly dark or bright
    Bugfix: Bugged room where bots and ai got stuck is fixed
Gameplay:Player is now Informed to pickup weapons
Gameplay:Player now starts with 2 weapons which also have detailed info
 Gameplay:Rifle now shots faster, more precise and more damaging bullet
 Gameplay:Magazine upped to 100 shots on rifle to avoid changing magazine ever so often
 Gameplay: Other rifle now shoots slower Plasma shots with very high damage
 Gameplay:Tutorial/Information/Shooting range room updated with tons of information on how to play
 Gameplay: Enemy Robots and enemies in general dont spawn in the same room
 Bug fix: Player don't randomly end up on roof
 Gameplay:Adjusted spots for weapons and ammo
 Gameplay: Prevented double spawning when boss is encountered
 Gameplay: Guardian Boss is now harder and takes more damage
Bugfix: Enemy droids don't explode unless they are far beyond reach of player
Improvements: Minor improvements to performance
Gameplay: Level generated has less branching reach to make it easier
 
 
Up and coming fixxes and improvements:

    New weapon models
New weapon functionality (secret!)
New weapons Grenades, Flamethrower, Plasma gun, Laser Sniper Rifle
New boss, Huge Mech!
 Gameplay improvements after forum feedback
 New level moduels
New missions
More bug fixing, game issues fixing and performance improvements
 

Get ready for some massive blasting and action, we are aiming to get this game to the top! Let us know in the forums what we did right, things that need urgent fixing and so on! 
And please, if things aren't what you expect, let us know in the forum and give us a chance to fix it first! We do this because we love making games and we try our best to please!

Thanks for putting up with us! <3 ːsteamhappyː
